Requirement: Provide one hiring platform and process for all 14 countries, with local variants handled by configuration.
Acceptance criteria: One requisition and candidate record per hire; no parallel ATS in use after final wave.

Requirement: Reduce median time-to-hire for volume roles and specialist roles.
Acceptance criteria: Median time-to-hire down [30]% against baseline within [12] months of each wave.

Requirement: Raise offer-acceptance and candidate satisfaction.
Acceptance criteria: Offer acceptance up [8] points; candidate satisfaction at or above [4.2]/5.

Requirement: Make every hire safe and compliant before day one, including medical, security and right-to-work gates.
Acceptance criteria: 100% of safety-critical hires carry a recorded clearance before start.

Requirement: Let OmniVerse add, replace or retire any assessment, interview, check or job-board partner without redesigning the platform.
Acceptance criteria: A new partner in an existing category is live in under [8] weeks using the same capability interface.

Requirement: Use AI to help people, with evidence that decisions stay human, fair and explainable.
Acceptance criteria: Bias report each month; human decision logged for 100% of selection steps.

Requirement: Lower cost per hire through better channel mix, automation and fewer tools.
Acceptance criteria: Cost per hire down [15]%; tool count for hiring reduced from [9] to [5] core services.

Requirement: Give leaders one trusted view of hiring demand, funnel, quality and cost.
Acceptance criteria: One dashboard set; refreshed at least daily; definitions agreed by the data council.

Requirement: Recruiters need one workspace for requisitions, candidates, communication, interviews and offers.
Acceptance criteria: Recruiter completes the daily workflow without leaving the hub for core steps.

Requirement: Hiring managers need to raise requisitions, review shortlists and give feedback from a phone or chat tool.
Acceptance criteria: Manager task completed on mobile in under [3] minutes in usability test.

Requirement: Candidates need to apply in their language in under [5] minutes and see their status.
Acceptance criteria: Mobile apply time at or below [5] minutes; status visible at every stage.

Requirement: Candidates need reasonable adjustments for assessments and interviews.
Acceptance criteria: Adjustment request path on every invitation; response in [2] working days.

Requirement: HR operations need hire data that creates a correct employee record without re-keying.
Acceptance criteria: Hire-to-employee error rate under [1]%; no manual re-keying of core fields.

Requirement: Legal and privacy need consent, retention, human-review rights and AI documentation they can evidence to regulators.
Acceptance criteria: Evidence pack for each country available on request within [5] days.

Requirement: HSE and security need clearance gates they can audit.
Acceptance criteria: Gate status and timestamp visible per candidate; monthly audit sample passes.

Requirement: Procurement needs vendor-neutral selection and exit terms for every partner.
Acceptance criteria: Scorecard completed for every partner; contract includes data return and audit rights.

Requirement: Create requisitions from approved positions, with templates, hiring team and approval chains.
Acceptance criteria: Requisition created from a position in under [5] minutes; approvals follow the configured chain.

Requirement: Post a job once and distribute it to selected boards and the career site, with tracking per channel.
Acceptance criteria: One action posts to all selected channels; source tracked on each application.

Requirement: Capture applications through career site, chat, job boards, referral and agency channels with consent.
Acceptance criteria: All channels create the same candidate and application record; consent stored.

Requirement: Offer conversational application and FAQ, including SMS and messaging apps where lawful.
Acceptance criteria: Chat completes an application end to end in supported languages; opt-in recorded.

Requirement: Show match advice and the reasons for it to recruiters, never as an automatic decision.
Acceptance criteria: Every match shows reasons and model version; no auto-reject switch is enabled.

Requirement: Order assessments from any approved assessment partner and receive results back on the candidate record.
Acceptance criteria: Order and result flow works for each approved partner through one capability interface.

Requirement: Invite candidates to AI-assisted or live video interviews and attach the record and structured feedback.
Acceptance criteria: Invitation, completion and summary visible on the candidate record within [5] minutes of completion.

Requirement: Let candidates self-schedule interviews against interviewer calendars.
Acceptance criteria: Slot booking checks calendar free/busy and sends invites; reschedule in one step.

Requirement: Build offers from templates, check pay band, route approvals and collect e-signature.
Acceptance criteria: Offer cannot be released outside band without approved exception; signed copy archived.

Requirement: Order background, education, employment, licence and sanctions checks by country package and show status.
Acceptance criteria: Packages configured per country; status updates visible; result stored as outcome only.

Requirement: Verify identity and right to work through a digital or assisted route before start.
Acceptance criteria: Verification outcome stored; mismatch blocks hire hand-off.

Requirement: Record medical fitness and safety clearance status for designated roles.
Acceptance criteria: Fit/not-fit flag and date stored; no clinical detail in the hiring system.

Requirement: Create the employee in the HR core from the accepted hire with mapped, validated data.
Acceptance criteria: Hire event creates one employee; failed mapping raises a work item, not a silent drop.

Requirement: Provide pre-boarding tasks and document collection, then hand over to onboarding.
Acceptance criteria: Tasks assigned at offer acceptance; completion rate reported.

Requirement: Offer internal mobility matches and employee referral tracking.
Acceptance criteria: Internal candidates see matched roles; referral source retained to hire.

Requirement: Handle consent changes, access requests, deletion and anonymisation automatically where possible.
Acceptance criteria: Requests logged and closed within the legal period; deletion propagated to partners.

Requirement: Gather candidate and manager feedback at key moments and feed it to analytics.
Acceptance criteria: Survey triggered at defined stages; results in analytics next day.

Requirement: Analyse job ads and funnel for inclusive language and parity.
Acceptance criteria: Flags raised on job ads; funnel parity report monthly.

Requirement: Hiring hub and integration hub meet availability targets for global use.
Acceptance criteria: Availability at or above [99.9]% monthly; planned maintenance outside regional business hours.

Requirement: Integration calls complete quickly and scale for campaign peaks.
Acceptance criteria: 95% of order/result calls under [3] s; peak of [500] applications per minute without loss.

Requirement: No data loss between partners and the hub.
Acceptance criteria: Idempotent processing, retry and dead-letter; reconciliation report daily shows zero unexplained gaps.

Requirement: All users sign in through enterprise single sign-on with multi-factor; roles are least privilege.
Acceptance criteria: No local passwords for staff; quarterly access review completed.

Requirement: Partner credentials are scoped, stored in a vault and rotated.
Acceptance criteria: No credentials in code or tickets; rotation evidence available.

Requirement: Candidate data is encrypted in transit and at rest; sensitive fields are protected further.
Acceptance criteria: Encryption verified in security review; field-level protection for identity and check data.

Requirement: Data is processed in approved regions with documented transfer controls.
Acceptance criteria: Region map per partner approved by privacy; regional controls enabled.

Requirement: Candidate-facing pages meet accessibility and mobile performance standards.
Acceptance criteria: WCAG 2.2 AA audit passed; mobile page load under [3] s on mid-range device.

Requirement: All partner integrations are monitored with alerts and an audit log.
Acceptance criteria: Dashboards and alerts live before go-live; logs kept [13] months.

Requirement: Each critical partner has a tested exit and data-return plan.
Acceptance criteria: Exit test completed annually for critical partners; data returned in agreed format.

Requirement: Platform supports at least [10] languages for candidates and [6] for staff.
Acceptance criteria: All candidate flows tested in each supported language.

Requirement: Recovery targets for the integration hub and data platform are defined and tested.
Acceptance criteria: RTO [4] h and RPO [1] h demonstrated in a test.

Requirement: Migrate open requisitions, active candidates and talent pools from legacy tools.
Acceptance criteria: Open requisitions and active pipelines loaded and reconciled; sign-off by regional TA lead.

Requirement: Define the retention rule for legacy candidate history and apply it before load.
Acceptance criteria: Records past retention are not migrated; rule approved by privacy.

Requirement: Train recruiters, coordinators and hiring managers by role before each wave.
Acceptance criteria: Trained share at or above [95]% before go-live; training content in each language.

Requirement: Run a hypercare period with defined support, escalation and hand-over to run.
Acceptance criteria: Hypercare exit criteria met; run team accepts hand-over.

Requirement: Switch job posting and applications to the new hub at cutover with a redirect plan for open jobs.
Acceptance criteria: No job without a live posting after cutover; legacy career pages redirect.

Requirement: Onboard partners in waves with contract tests and a rollback path.
Acceptance criteria: Each partner passes contract tests and security review before production.
